query:
SELECT b.id            AS "blob_id!",
                  b.content_hash  AS "content_hash!",
                  b.content_type,
                  b.content_bytes AS "content_bytes!",
                  b.created       AS "created!"
             FROM kb_blobs b
            WHERE blob_readable_by_profile($1, b.id)
              AND ($2::text IS NULL
                     OR (b.home_table = $2::text AND b.home_id = $3))
